test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit to the right of X. Only two people sit between X and Q. Only two people sit between O and P. P sits to the immediate left of X. R sits to the immediate right of Y. Who sits at the third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of X.

Only two people sit between X and Q.

Only two people sit between O and P.

P sits to the immediate left of X.

R sits to the immediate right of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70028c1c3f168af70aded682f384237ce97b0fa3fb639cf6497b971e897e6e01.png] 

Now, the third position from the left end is W.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
